item.title: Ameyoko Market — Guide
item.description: Ameyoko (short for Ameya-Yokocho) is a vibrant, chaotic open-air market that stretches for around 400 metres along and beneath the elevated train tracks between Ueno and Okachimachi stations. Born as a black market in the post-war years, it has kept a raw, energetic, old-Tokyo bazaar atmosphere quite unlike the city’s polished shopping districts. Around 400 stalls and shops are crammed together, vendors calling out their wares, selling everything from fresh seafood, dried goods and exotic snacks to sweets, spices, tea, clothing, cosmetics, sneakers and discount goods, often at bargain prices with room to haggle.
